limitations: Two fixed line grammars and three chunk sizes model segmentation, EOF flushing, cancellation and errors after DONE. This projection does not model arbitrary JSON or Unicode decoding.

The shared runner executes the real meter's five tests, including every byte split of a Unicode response, long complete payloads, malformed events and cancellation. Billing authorization and provider execution remain separate protocols.
The model permits an indefinitely idle provider. It establishes safety under segmentation, not provider progress or a production performance bound.
